components: A reversible register at the common hub tracks the channel after an aligned departure. Only the contact of an independent even reference ring reads it. Exact phase-orbit counts distinguish the microscopic square shares, linear lap counts and uniform switch counts; a neutral triangle can tolerate ring periods that fail on four occupied rails.
candidates.declared_status: Finite passive-clock construction and conditional arithmetic classification, not a general clock law, physical dimensions, independent sampling or first-principles Born rule.
missing_bridges: Establish which trigger and relative speed inside a physical detector are independently realized and how the latch and active signal are prepared.

components: The observer uses a duplicate of the active unary apparatus with two extra wire vertices on one marked-lane edge. One local marked departure per reference orbit has period T+2; sampling the signal latch at every departure sweeps a full parity class. Every contiguous signal dwell is divisible by two.
candidates.declared_status: Complete relative-phase coverage for a fixed matched preparation under homogeneous hopping; neither arbitrary external cadence nor copying an unknown quantum state.
missing_bridges: Construct the matched unary reference from the source without assuming free duplicate preparation, align both active sectors, and account for clock rates and the cost per reported event.

components: Deliver the held rail on every external stimulus and advance a reference apparatus. One withheld main hop per reference tour M produces a phase shift Mh-1 over M stimuli of positive fixed interval h. Equal-delay local fanout distributes the enable signals, and a matched active clone realizes M=T without loading weights.
candidates.declared_status: Prepared detector under constant external cadence; there is no claim of independence, short-horizon fairness, reversibility of the control tree or robustness to arbitrary retuning.
missing_bridges: Derive the external trigger, clock distribution, memory and active preparation. Explain how a physical changing input would preserve or replace these fixed-period controls.

components: Two equal-speed heads on raw signed occurrences and their one-cell-padded copy realize all ordered pairs in time. A local debt register charges opposite-role meetings and pays them from later equal-role meetings. On a stable repeated input, after one declared silent priming period, the remaining clicks per channel equal its net signed current squared.
candidates.declared_status: Exact conditional counts for fixed raw lists and sparse click service, not a lossless detector, unconditioned unit efficiency or single-particle energy transfer.
missing_bridges: Explain synchronized raw copies, same-channel role comparison, priming and inherited debt under source changes; preserve all silent ticks.

components: For a repeated external interval word of length P and sum H, an active carry apparatus with reference period M advances (M/g)H-P/g signal phases per joint calendar block, where g=gcd(P,M). It can tolerate all alternating cadences for the stated matched petal family but other regular timing patterns can bias a correctly functioning detector.
candidates.declared_status: Exact conditional phase-sweep criterion and finite delayed hardware controls, not independent physical emission or robustness to arbitrary aperiodic drives.
missing_bridges: Identify the actual external calendar, prior timing, phase record and measurement window without phase averaging or omitting the cost of a delayed trigger.
